notes.title: Replay, Spectate and Graphs!
notes.content:
Good news, everyone!

Today we are [b]releasing three new features[/b] for Through the Ages - [b]Replay, Spectate, and Graphs![/b]

With Spectate and Replay mode, you can [b]rewatch any moment from your favorite games[/b], games of your friends (if they share their special code with you), or spectate exciting tournaments. AND at the end of each game, you can [b]review everything in a form of adjustable Graphs[/b].

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/32281238/da206711e1beb3cfb3d21ee81892bbbdaa0749d8.gif[/img]

[b]More changes:[/b]
- Graphics renderer options (Windows only)
- Fixed occasional incorrect behavior of International Agreement in combination with Fleming or Coubertin
- Fixed challenge syncing issues
- Other minor improvements and optimizations

notes.title: New update including community translations and more
notes.content:
Community translations are here! Huge thanks to everyone who helped us with all the new localizations! Whoever is missing their language in the game is always free to join the community effort – just drop us a message here: community.localizations@czechgames.com 

Full list of what's new in the update:
- We have launched the first community translations (French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese) with more languages to come later (you can join the effort, too)
- An official Korean localization has also been added
- Income management becomes easier – you can now easily see where all your food, resources, science, culture, happy faces, and strength come from
- Lobby and game chat have been improved

Enjoy the game!
CGE Digital team

tags.feature: - We have launched the first community translations (French, Italian, Brazilian Portuguese) with more languages to come later (you can join the effort, too)
- An official Korean localization has also been added

- Lobby and game chat have been improved
